title: Incident Breadcrumbs + Retry Triage Carousel
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, developer-focused debugging surface that lives in the Redwood Console request view: an 'Incident Breadcrumbs' timeline that surfaces micro-checkpoints for failed requests and a horizontal 'Retry Triage Carousel' that suggests lightweight mitigations and quick replays. Goal: reduce time-to-first-successful-retry for transient failures and make root-cause clues (model vs runtime vs network vs quota) visible without leaving the request context.
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumbs timeline is visible on request detail pages and shows at least 5 checkpoint types (ingest, routing, model-infer, kv-cache, downstream-push)
Each breadcrumb expands to show a concise payload snapshot (timestamp, status code/error class, latency, token delta) and an inline 'snapshot diff' toggle that highlights changed KV keys
Retry Triage Carousel surfaces 3 automated retry options (fast retry, cached-prefix replay, downgraded model reroute) with estimated success probability and cost delta
Prototype validated with 6 backend engineers and 4 product engineers; at least 80% report faster triage flow in moderated tasks
Design handoff includes component specs, accessibility notes, and CSS tokens for badges and chips
design_decisions: Use compact horizontal timeline to conserve vertical space in request view; expand to full panel on click
Verdict badges map to canonical taxonomy: MODEL | RUNTIME | NETWORK | QUOTA | UNKNOWN
Inline retry actions are optimistic and client-driven; POST to /replay endpoint with prepopulated payload variants
Show estimated cost impact as a micro-meter (0-100) and a simple color gradient to aid quick decisions
Keep KV snapshot diff lightweight: show top 3 changed keys, link out to full payload in inspector
components_spec: Breadcrumb node: 40px circular badge + 1-line label + hover tooltip (timestamp + short reason)
Breadcrumb expanded panel: 280px card with small payload preview, diff button, trace-id link, and 'Replay' CTA
Retry Triage Carousel card: title, short rationale, probability score, cost delta, primary CTA (Run) and secondary (Preview)
Verdict badge system: micro-icon + color token + accessible label; map to taxonomy IDs used by backend
Backoff visualizer: small sparkline showing historical retry outcomes for the request series
usability_notes: Moderated test (n=10) tasks: find root cause, pick a safe retry path; median completion time 3m 15s vs baseline 6m 40s
Participants liked the inline cost meter but wanted clearer units (we'll show 'estimated tokens' text on hover)
Accessibility: ensure breadcrumb nodes have 48px hit target and keyboard focus order matches timeline sequence
review_feedback: PM (Anika Patel): prefer 'Preview' before running optimistic retries for high-cost plans
Eng (Sven Johansen): backend can supply top-3 KV diffs via /request-snapshots endpoint but needs schema v2; added ENG-2418 dependency
Security (Riley Park): flagged that replaying requests must respect PII redaction settings; design to include redaction indicator
Design (Lead, Grace Li): reduce label verbosity on breadcrumb hover to one-line summaries to avoid visual clutter
